dashboard.label: Governance Settings
dashboard.description: Configure thresholds and settings for scheduled search governance

div.p: Configure the thresholds used to identify suspicious scheduled searches. Changes take effect immediately.

search.query: `get_governance_settings` | table setting_name, setting_value, description | rename setting_name as "Setting", setting_value as "Value", description as "Description"

html.p: Maximum allowed runtime as a percentage of the schedule interval. Searches exceeding this ratio will be flagged as suspicious.

button.onclick: updateSetting('runtime_ratio_threshold', '$new_runtime_ratio$', 'Maximum runtime as percentage of schedule interval')

html.p: Minimum interval (in seconds) between scheduled runs. Searches running more frequently than this will be flagged.

button.onclick: updateSetting('high_frequency_threshold', '$new_frequency_threshold$', 'Minimum seconds between runs to flag as high frequency')

html.p: Maximum average runtime (in seconds) before a search is flagged as long-running.

button.onclick: updateSetting('long_runtime_threshold', '$new_runtime_threshold$', 'Runtime in seconds to flag as long running')

html.p: Number of days users have to remediate flagged searches before they are automatically disabled.

button.onclick: updateSetting('remediation_days', '$new_remediation_days$', 'Days allowed for remediation before auto-disable')

div.p: The email domain used when sending notifications to search owners. Owner usernames are appended with this domain.

p.em: To change this, edit the JavaScript file or use the input below.

html.p: Email address for admin team notifications (weekly reports, alerts).

p.em: Note: Update savedsearches.conf to change actual alert recipients.

ul.li: earliest=-30d or longer - Extended time ranges

p.em: To customize these patterns, edit the macros.conf file.

search.query: | rest /servicesNS/-/TA-user-governance/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search is_scheduled=1 | table title, cron_schedule, disabled, next_scheduled_time | rename title as "Search Name", cron_schedule as "Schedule", disabled as "Disabled", next_scheduled_time as "Next Run"

| inputlookup flagged_searches_lookup | stats count as "Total Flagged" count(eval(status="pending")) as "Pending" count(eval(status="notified")) as "Awaiting Remediation" count(eval(status="disabled")) as "Disabled" count(eval(status="resolved")) as "Resolved" | transpose | rename column as "Status", "row 1" as "Count"

| inputlookup governance_audit_log_lookup | stats count as "Total Actions" count(eval(action="flagged")) as "Flagged" count(eval(action="disabled")) as "Disabled" count(eval(action="unflagged")) as "Unflagged" count(eval(action="extended")) as "Extended" earliest(timestamp) as first_action latest(timestamp) as last_action | eval first_action = strftime(first_action, "%Y-%m-%d") | eval last_action = strftime(last_action, "%Y-%m-%d") | transpose | rename column as "Metric", "row 1" as "Value"
